Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, A.K. GANGULY
10 S.C.R. 1070 MIS. KRANTI ASSOCIATES PVT. LTD. & ANR. V. SH. MASOOD AHMED KHAN & OTHERS (Civil Appeal No. 7472 of 2010) SEPTEMBER 08, 2010 (G..S. SINGHVI AND ASOK KUMAR GANGULY, J.J.] Judgment/Order: Necessity of reasons - Held: Reasons are indispensablacomponent of a decision making conclusions - National Commission has the trappings of a civil court and is a high-powered quasi-judicial forum for D deciding /is between the parties - A non-reasoned order passed by National Commission is thus liable to be set aside - Consumer Protection Act, 1986 - ss. 13, 22 - Penal Code, 1860
Decision Date : 08-09-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7472/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
